title: A fresh look for the Gauntlet and titles
changes: The Gauntlet shows every character's form, and you can pick which form your character fights in.
Redesigned Gauntlet page, gauntlet duel rounds and results, and the 9:16 story image.
Titles now replace each other as you climb: reach Veteran and it replaces Fighter. New colors and badges, a crown for the Weekly Champion, and a simpler title picker in Profile settings.
Admins no longer earn titles for overrule suggestions.

title: Discord roles from your Powerscale stats
changes: Discord servers can now give out roles based on your Powerscale stats: duel wins, approved overrule suggestions, weekly champion or founder.
Claim one from the server's Linked Roles menu. Signing in there also connects your Discord to your Powerscale account, and your roles update as you win duels.

title: Matchup images for TikTok and stories
changes: Share ▾ on any matchup can now save a 9:16 image, sized for TikTok, Shorts, Reels and stories, next to the square one.
Matchup and character pages show up better in search results, with titles like "Kirby vs Hulk: who would win?" and the verdict in the description.

title: Titles
changes: Earn titles that show next to your name on the Board, in comments, in duels and on the leaderboard.
Duel wins: Rookie at 1, then Challenger, Contender, Fighter, Veteran, Champion, Elite, Master, Grandmaster and Mythic, all the way to Legend at 1,000 wins.
Approved overrule suggestions: Scout, Analyst, Arbiter and Oracle. Last week's #1 duelist is the Weekly Champion, and the first 100 accounts are Founders.
Your profile shows every title you've earned and how close you are to the next. Pick which one shows (or none) in Profile settings.

title: The Gauntlet
changes: New Gauntlet page: pick any character (or a random one) and watch how far it climbs a ladder of ever-stronger opponents. It stops at its first loss.
Opponents can come from the whole roster (rung 1 is among the weakest characters on the site, rung 10 among the strongest), from one series' best-known characters, or from your own picks.
Gauntlet duels: guess how far each of five characters climbs. 3 points for the exact number, 2 if you're one off, 1 if two off. Also on Discord with /duel.
Every character page has a Gauntlet button, and each run has a link you can share.

title: Stat fixes: Ultimate Hulk and 14 more
changes: Ultimate Hulk's Hulk form was scored at Banner's Human level. It's Mountain level now.
The same fix gives 14 more characters their real stats per form, among them Simon the Digger's final form, Captain Atom, Orion, Highfather and the Spectre.
Duels: after creating a game, the "created" box goes away once you press Play now.

title: Nintendo: Mario, Zelda, Kirby and Metroid
changes: 464 Nintendo characters join: Super Mario Bros (173), The Legend of Zelda (112), Kirby (138) and Metroid (41).

Mario is split into Games, Paper Mario, Donkey Kong, Wario and Other Media (the 1993 movie, the Super Show, the comics). Zelda has every Link by game, plus Hyrule Warriors and Other Media (the CD-i games, the cartoons). Kirby has Games, Anime and Manga.
Settle Kirby vs Meta Knight, Ganondorf vs Bowser, or which Link is strongest.
Tidier names across the site: notes in brackets are gone from names ("Alecto", not "Alecto (Greek: ...)"), and characters the wiki calls "Unknown" go by their real title.

title: Faster search, and fixes
changes: Searching Characters across All no longer freezes phones: results show as you scroll instead of thousands at once.
Don't want challenges from your profile? Untick "Show a Challenge button on my profile" in Profile settings.
Profiles no longer leave big gaps between their sections.
The Discord matchup of the day reveals the matchup that was actually posted (it once showed the wrong one after an update).
Celestialsapiens has its picture.
New Terms of Service and Privacy Policy pages (linked from the FAQ and the sign-up form).

title: Challenge anyone
changes: New game → Who can join → Friends with the link: a game only the people you send the link to can join, in any mode or format. It isn't listed under Open games or posted on Discord, so no stranger takes your friend's seat.
Challenge a friend from Compare works the same way now.
Every profile has a Challenge button: it sets up a 1v1 inviting that player, and it shows up on their Duels page.

title: A FAQ page
changes: New FAQ page (the ? at the top of every page): how verdicts are worked out, why abilities don't count, what overrules are, how prediction duels and draft work, the Discord app's commands, and your account.
Compare links straight to it: "How it's worked out" under the verdict, and "Why?" next to the ability warning.
Each answer has its own link, so you can send someone the exact one.

title: Share matchups and challenge your friends
changes: Compare has a Share menu: copy the link, post it to Reddit or X, or use your phone's share sheet.

Challenge a friend: from any matchup, make a duel with that matchup in it and send the link. Your friend lands on a "You're challenged" card and joins in one tap (or logs in first and comes right back).
Duel results can be shared too.
Tucked at the bottom of the Share menu: save the matchup as an image, ready to post.

title: Marvel part 3: the MCU, films, cartoons and games
changes: 570 more Marvel characters from the adaptations, each in its own filter: MCU (217), Fox films (58), Sony films (21, including Venom), other films (Blade, Hulk 2003), Animated (107, including Spectacular Spider-Man, EMH and the Spider-Verse movies) and Games (142: Insomniac's Spider-Man, Marvel Rivals, Marvel vs. Capcom's Marvel side, Lego Marvel and more).
Marvel now has 1,128 characters. Settle MCU Thor vs comics Thor, or Fox Wolverine vs the Deadpool & Wolverine one.
Characters whose names differ only by "The" now show which version they are, e.g. The Mandarin (Lego).

title: Marvel part 2: the villains and the cosmic tier
changes: 321 more Marvel Comics characters: Galactus, Magneto, Kingpin, Mephisto, Dormammu, Apocalypse, Knull, the Living Tribunal, the One Above All and many more. Marvel now has 558.
More Ultimate universe characters, plus Marvel Age and Mangaverse versions under Other media.
Iron Man's individual armor models and items like the Infinity Stones and Mjolnir aren't separate characters.

title: Draft: too close to call is a tie
changes: In a draft, picks the site calls "too close to call" now count as even, so the faster pick wins them (marked "faster pick"), instead of whoever the calculator leaned to by a hair. Finished games keep their scores.
Compare shows plain names under the verdict meter, not each character's whole list of aliases.

title: Duel pictures match the form
changes: Duels show the picture of the form the round actually uses: God Dimple looks like God Dimple, Cosmic Garou like Cosmic Garou. It fixes 347 characters, and the Discord bot's pictures and shared matchup links too.

title: Marvel is here (part 1)
changes: 235 Marvel Comics characters join: the Avengers, X-Men, Fantastic Four, Guardians of the Galaxy, Defenders, Inhumans, Eternals and Asgardians, plus the Sinister Six, Masters of Evil and Thunderbolts.
The Ultimate universe has its own filter, since it rates heroes differently (Ultimate Captain America beats the main one).
Marvel characters go by the names fans use - Doctor Doom, Mister Fantastic, Black Cat - and searching their real names still finds them.

title: Mortal Kombat, Street Fighter and Tekken
changes: 259 fighting-game characters join: Mortal Kombat (121), Street Fighter (103) and Tekken (35).

Mortal Kombat is split by continuity, since the eras rate fighters very differently: Original Timeline, Second Timeline, New Era, Legends, Films & Shows, and the guest fighters (Kratos, the Joker, Homelander and more, as they are in MK).
Characters now show by the name people call them: Jax, Jacqui Briggs, Nightwolf, Johnny Joestar, Venom Snake, Rick Flag and a few more.

title: Your Discord on your profile
changes: Linked your Discord? Your Powerscale profile now shows it, and /profile in Discord shows who you are on both.
Right-click anyone in Discord → Apps → Powerscale profile to see their profile.
Rather keep them apart? Untick "Show it on my public profile" in Profile settings: it hides the link both ways.

title: Matchup of the day on Discord, and duels from Discord
changes: Every day at 17:00 (Budapest time) the Discord gets the matchup of the day as a poll. The next day shows what the site says next to how everyone voted.
The matchup of the day is now a close fight between well-known characters from different series, the same one as the button on the Characters page.
Connect your Discord to your account: type /link, then confirm on the site (Profile settings shows it).
Once connected, /duel starts a game right from Discord (pick the mode and format, or challenge someone), and /profile works with @mentions.

title: Find opponents on Discord, and 32 characters get their forms
changes: Start a duel that's open to anyone and it's posted in the Discord's duels channel, so others can jump in. The post shows the seats left and disappears once the game is full or cancelled.
32 characters now have their real forms instead of one: Johnny Joestar's Tusk Act 1–4, Frieza, Gohan, Josuke, Nezuko, Lex Luthor, Billy Butcher and more.
Fixed finished duels sometimes being announced twice on Discord.

title: /profile on Discord
changes: New bot command: /profile shows anyone's Powerscale profile right in Discord: their posts, likes, duel record and rank, favorite character and latest duels. Names are suggested as you type.

title: A new logo
changes: Powerscale has a proper logo now: the P mark, on the site, the browser tab and your phone's home screen.

title: The Powerscale Discord app, The Boys, and a better Draft
changes: The Powerscale app is here: /compare, /character, /random and /leaderboard. Add it to your server or to your own account and use it anywhere.
Join our Discord server from the new Discord button at the top of every page.
The Boys joins as its own series (TV Series, Gen V and the comics), and DC gets the rest of Wildstorm and Watchmen.
Draft results: tap a head-to-head to open it on Compare, or any card to open that character. Picks that are dead even on stats now go to whoever locked in faster.
Duels show each character's full name and form, and you can cancel your open games straight from the list again.
Links to duels, profiles and tournaments now show a proper preview when you share them.
Every Monday at 18:00 (Budapest time) the week's duel leaderboard is posted on the Discord.
